Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.

Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil style, correct feline anatomy and rounded bust framing; do not copy its face, eyes, quiff or beige overshirt.

Natural facial proportions, a short feline muzzle, small elegant cat nose and fine whiskers. Warm muted sandy/taupe fur with cream muzzle/cheek highlights, subtle natural facial marks. Composition: square canvas, one centered UPRIGHT near-frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, shoulders turned only gently as in the source, head looking toward viewer, full ears/head/shoulders inside frame, rounded lower bust silhouette with ample transparent margins.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the wooden wall, bench, grid ceiling, room, furniture, and both other women. Only one character, no props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
